The formulation preserves each element separately: water-area conversion purpose and possible flow/circulation impairment or reach reduction are not reduced to crop change or harm alone. O'Connor's PUD No. 1 writing and her recorded statutory-trigger objection supply a concrete advantage in preserving the necessary limited formulation; Souter's Sweet Home opinion also supplies causal and statutory precision. Stone's approved act/purpose/remedy separation directly supports the complete formulation. All six full supporters remain eligible; no author may broaden the rule beyond O'Connor's recorded boundaries, and Scalia/Thomas are not eligible for the whole lead because they reject liability. The necessary accommodation is fully specified by the frozen reconciliation; no new circulation or vote change is assumed.
